title: File Upload Bypass
description: Four approaches: blacklist, whitelist, parser discrepancies, and race conditions
detail:
Blacklist: .php5 .phtml .phps; asp → asa/cdx/cer; case changes, trailing dot, ::$DATA (Windows), spaces.
Whitelist: 00 truncation (legacy environments), double extensions combined with parser vulnerabilities, image web shell + file inclusion vulnerability.
Parser vulnerabilities: nginx space in PHP filename (older versions), Apache multi-suffix parsing x.php.abc, IIS 6 semicolon.
Race condition: continuously upload and continuously access, combined with a temporary file that can be included after deletion.
Exploitation chain: upload → record the URL as a loot fact → connect (AntSword/manual payload) → locate sensitive target files first, then escalate privileges.
